body.x: A wireless technology-enabling firm, will exhibit its latest consumer electronics solutions and intellectual property advancements at the 2012 International CES, the world’s largest consumer technology tradeshow, scheduled for January 10 through January 13 in Las Vegas.

A leader in text-messaging technologies, Cherple(cherple.com) will demonstrate its PC-to-mobile cellular phone SMS solutions including several new applications that have been localized for use in Brazil, Mexico, Philippines and India. CHE, a wholly owned, global marketing and public relations consultancy, will also be introduced. As a new business unit of Cherple, CHE's marketing, public relations and digital services activate mobile and online marketing campaigns using Cherple as a turnkey solution.

CES recently named Cherple as one of the winners of its viral video contest, Visit at CES, in which participants created YouTube videos to lure attendees to their exhibits at CES. As a result, Cherple received a month of free promotion on the CES homepage.

More information on its products and services to be showcased at CES will be made public by CEO and President Robert Sanchez at a special event on CES Media Day, January 9 from 1:30 p.m. to 2 at the Venetian Hotel, ballroom D.
Cherple will be exhibiting from 35703 in the upper south hall of the Las Vegas Convention Center.
